risks.proof: Video of the camera powering on, navigating menus, and taking a photo

risks.risk: Shutter count is high or unknown

proof_requests: Video of the camera turning on, navigating the menu, and firing the shutter
Screenshot or photo of the shutter count in the camera's information menu
Close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements
Photos of the battery and charger if included
response.reason: The item is identifiable from the photos as a Nikon DSLR camera with a 70-300mm lens; the seller's added text provides no verifiable evidence, so it is priced at its worst case.
